issue: Are FBAR penalties under 31 U.S.C. § 5321 'fines' subject to review under the Eighth Amendment's Excessive Fines Clause?
provision: 31 U.S.C. § 5321; U.S. Const. amend. VIII (Excessive Fines Clause)

sides.position: FBAR penalties do not fall within the Excessive Fines Clause because they are not fines for Eighth Amendment purposes.
FBAR penalties are in substantial measure punitive and therefore are subject to Excessive Fines Clause review.
cases: United States v. Schwarzbaum, 127 F.4th 259 (11th Cir. 2025)

this_court: FBAR penalties are subject to Excessive Fines Clause review; the court expressly declines to follow the First Circuit.
quote: The only other circuit court to have addressed the question, the First Circuit, recently held that the Eighth Amendment's Excessive Fines Clause does not apply to FBAR penalties.
cite: United States v. Isac Schwarzbaum, 127 F.4th 259 (11th Cir. 2025)
